definition: Tangential means only incidentally or superficially related to the main topic; off to the side of the real subject.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word tangential. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know tangential should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: His tangential story about airport food had almost nothing to do with the budget question on the table.
A secondary point still belongs to the main discussion, just with less weight, while a tangential point only brushes against the topic before heading its own way.
A tangential remark still touches the topic at one small point, but an irrelevant one has no connection to it at all.

Peripheral means on the outer edge of what matters - in the picture but far from its center. A peripheral issue still belongs to the discussion. Tangential is a verdict about direction: the remark touches the topic at one point and then heads off on its own line. Peripheral details sit at the margin; tangential ones lead the conversation away.

Digressive describes the wandering itself - a speaker or passage that drifts away from the main subject, often pleasantly and at length. Tangential judges the content's relation to the topic: connected at only one small point. A digressive lecturer keeps leaving the road; a tangential anecdote was barely on the road to begin with.

The agenda item was narrow: should the library stay open on Sundays?
Arden reached the microphone and began with the library's Sunday hours — for one sentence.
Then, because the library and the lighthouse were built the same year, she was off: lighthouse paint, lighthouse tours, the gift shop's postcard sales.
The moderator let it run five minutes before calling the comment tangential and asking for speakers with points about the budget itself.
Arden protested that everything was connected.
In a sense she was right: her remarks had touched the library exactly once.
But one point of contact is not a connection an agenda can use, and the room moved on to the question it had actually gathered to answer.
